model_annotation: The pie chart represents the integration of design in the product development process within an organization. It is divided into five categories, each with a distinct color and corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored green, represents "Good is integrated" and constitutes 25% of the chart. The second largest, in purple, is "Somewhat good is integrated" at 24%. The blue segment, "Not integrated at all," accounts for 20%. The red segment, "Not integrated," makes up 8%, and the smallest segment, in orange, represents "Not integrated at all" with 10%. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest segment at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
